body.purpose: All working UI, labels, controls, and data.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a working surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); padding: 0 16px; font: 600 14px/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A clear 44px field for operational forms and search.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); padding: 0 14px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Surface
components.description: A flat, divided container for related operational content.
components.css: .ds-surface { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); padding: 20px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-surface p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Icon-and-label sidebar navigation with a warm selected state.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--sidebar-foreground); padding: 0 12px; text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sidebar-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: A compact outlined label for tags and entity groups.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--foreground); padding: 3px 8px; font: 500 11px/1.3 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Hindsight feels like a well-kept technical notebook translated into a live operations tool: calm enough for sustained focus, structured enough for dense data, and warm enough to feel considered.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral work surfaces with ink-heavy typography.
Clay used sparingly for action, selection, and focus.
Tonal layering and precise dividers instead of floating cards.
Fully paired light and dark themes.

rules.name: The Clay Signal Rule
rules.body: Clay marks action, current selection, or meaningful data. It is never a decorative wash across routine surfaces.

rules.name: The Operational Type Rule
rules.body: Serif is reserved for the auth brand moment; the working interface uses one sans family.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Static dashboard surfaces use a border or a tonal step, never a wide ambient shadow.

dos: Do keep the active bank and current section visible.
Do use Clay Action for primary actions, selection, focus, and meaningful chart emphasis.
Do preserve 44px interactive targets, visible focus rings, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
donts: Don't use generic blue-on-black SaaS dashboards.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism, neon glows, or purple gradients.
Don't embed authentication screens inside the authenticated application shell.
